page.overview:
Who is Deemus Abrus?

Deemus Abrus was a female Twi'lek who served as the Chief Inspector of the Coronet City Chapter of the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts during the High Republic Era. Alongside Corellian authorities, Abrus participated in the arrest of the notorious Shani singer Crufeela for attempting to eat the Bonbrak Teetak. Abrus suggested sending Teetak to the Blue Peaks of Corellia in attempt to repopulate the area.

Deemus Abrus appeared in Midnight Horizon, a 2022 novel written by Daniel José Older for the the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project's In the novel, Deemus Abrus and the Arcona Smeemarm share a moment of pointed eye contact with each other after the women collaborated to imprison Crufeela. On Twitter, Older confirmed that he had written the scene to convey that Smeemarm and Abrus were "shmanging" together. Though he initially felt it was clearly portrayed, he later acknowledged some readers found the text unclear when responding to fellow Star Wars author Alyssa Wong about two of their characters—Chelli Lona Aphra and Domina Tagge—who had a similar situation happen.
